sources.title: Deal feeds
sources.description: Which community deal feeds to read.

keywords.title: Only deals mentioning
keywords.description: Only return deals whose title, description, store or category contains one of these words, e.g. laptop, lego, nike. Leave empty for all deals.

excludeKeywords.title: Skip deals mentioning
excludeKeywords.description: Skip deals that contain any of these words.

minScore.title: Minimum community score
minScore.description: Only deals with at least this score: Slickdeals thumbs, hotukdeals temperature (°) or OzBargain net votes. Leave empty for all.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Only deals whose price is at most this amount, in the deal's own currency (USD, GBP or AUD). Deals without a price are skipped when this is set.

onlyCashback.title: Only deals mentioning cashback
onlyCashback.description: Only return deals that mention cash back or a cashback site (TopCashback, Rakuten, Quidco, ShopBack, Cashrewards).

onlyNew.title: Only new deals since the last run
onlyNew.description: Skip deals this Actor already returned in earlier runs with the same state name. Turn on for scheduled alerts.

stateName.title: State name
stateName.description: With 'Only new deals', deals already returned are remembered under this name. Use a different name for each separate schedule.
